## Checklist

- [ ] I followed [STYLE_GUIDE.md](../STYLE_GUIDE.md): danger first, quick steps, exact numbers in metric and imperial, plain words.
- [ ] `python3 tools/build.py --check` passes.
- [ ] For code changes: the tests pass (`python3 -m unittest discover -s tools -p "test_*.py"`).
- [ ] I read my article in `dist/just-in-case.txt` and it makes sense as plain text.
- [ ] The text is my own words, or comes from a public domain or CC BY-SA source that I cite.
- [ ] If I changed a fact in a reviewed article, I set `reviewed: no` (unless I am the qualified reviewer).
- [ ] I agree to license my contribution under CC BY-SA 4.0 (content) or MIT (code).
